title: 第19章 御兽峰弟子当真无法无天第20章 御兽峰倒霉了
slug: 让你修仙没让你祸害修仙界啊
content_zh:
“你们来了？”
秦宇的声音突然从身后响起，吓得小智等人一个激灵。
“宇哥，是你啊，吓死我了。”
戴着头套的小智捋了捋胸口说道。
“你们带个这玩意干嘛？”
秦宇指了指他们头上的头套。
“我们这不是害怕被发现嘛！”
另一个弟子解释道。
“怕个屁，集市上哪还有人，这个点驴都滚回家了。”
“再说，就你们这三脚猫的功夫，真被发现了还能跑的掉？”
“看你们这鬼鬼祟祟的样子，一看就是心中有鬼，反而更容易吸引别人的注意！”
小智等人急忙把头套摘了。
秦宇：“把头套拿过来，我给你们保管。”
小智等人乖乖把头套交给秦宇，亲眼目睹秦宇将他们的头套戴在自己的头上。
小智：“...宇哥，怎么你还带上了？”
秦宇：“你懂个屁，因为我是领头的，肯定要承担最大的风险。”
“你要是执法者，看到一群正常的人和一个戴着头套的人，你会先抓谁？”
小智惭愧的低下头，低声说道：“会抓带头套的人。”
“没错，他们来抓我，你们就有机会逃跑了。”
众人满脸惭愧：“宇哥，对不起，我们错怪你了。”

“你们还都不了解我，我不怪你们，但你们要记住，我秦某人是绝对不会害自己兄弟。”
“御兽峰那群畜生迫害的是你们，和我秦某人没有任何关系，我秦某人只是看不惯御兽峰的所作所为，看不惯我们杂役弟子如此被欺负，才绝对插手此事。”
“即便如此，我秦某人会承担最大风险，如果我秦某人被抓了，绝对不会供出你们任何一人。”
“同时我也希望，如果你们不幸被抓，不要供出其他任何一个兄弟。”
秦宇说的如此慷慨激昂，小智等人满脸的感动。
宇哥真是世间第一伟大之人！
“宇哥放心，就算我被移出宗门，也绝对不会供出任何一人。”
“俺也一样！”
“行了，大家去按计划行事吧！”
“注意分散一点，把现场弄得逼真一点。”
“弄完这边，还有中央广场那边也要布置一下。”
“我打听过了，执法峰弟子会在凌晨两点、凌晨四点各巡查一次，所以大家只有一个时辰的时间，赶紧加快进度吧！”
众人扛着麻袋走后，秦宇给李正通递去一个黑色头套。
“今天来的有些匆忙，都忘记带这个了，还是这群小弟子们想的周到！”
李正通接过黑色头套，困惑的看着秦宇。
秦宇一巴掌拍在李正通后脑勺上，“傻啊，执法者不会去抓戴头套的，他们只会抓跑的最慢的。”
‘不是兄弟不讲义气，而是兄弟也有先后顺序啊！
’秦宇在心中想着。
李正通恍然大悟。
“原来如此！”

随后，李正通将头套还给秦宇。
秦宇：“什么意思？”
李正通：“我就是那个跑的最慢的。”
秦宇：“......”
content_en:
"You guys are here?"
Qin Yu's voice suddenly sounded from behind, frightening Xiaozhi and others.
"Brother Yu, it's you, you scared me to death."
Xiaozhi, who was wearing a hood, rubbed his chest and said.
"Why do you bring this thing?"
Qin Yu pointed to the hoods on their heads.
"Aren't we afraid of being discovered?"
Another disciple explained.
"You're so scared, there's no one else in the market, this little donkey has to go home."
"Besides, with your skills as a three-legged cat, can you really run away if you are discovered?"
"Looking at how sneaky you are, it's obvious that there's something going on in your mind, which makes it easier to attract other people's attention!"
Xiaozhi and others quickly took off their hoods.
Qin Yu: "Bring the hood over here and I'll keep it for you."
Xiaozhi and others obediently handed their hoods to Qin Yu and witnessed Qin Yu putting their hoods on his heads.
Xiaozhi: "...Brother Yu, why do you still bring it with you?"
Qin Yu: "You know nothing, because I am the leader and I must bear the greatest risk."
"If you were a law enforcement officer and saw a group of normal people and a person wearing a hood, who would you arrest first?"
Xiaozhi lowered his head in shame and whispered: "I know how to catch people wearing hoods."
"Yes, if they come to catch me, you will have a chance to escape."
Everyone's face was full of shame: "Brother Yu, I'm sorry, we wrongly blamed you."
"You don't understand me yet. I don't blame you, but you have to remember that I, Mr. Qin, will never harm my brothers."
"It's you who are being persecuted by those beasts at Yushou Peak. It has nothing to do with me, Mr. Qin. I, Mr. Qin, just can't stand what Yushou Peak is doing, and can't stand that our handyman disciples are being bullied like this, so I absolutely intervened in this matter."
"Even so, I, Mr. Qin, will bear the greatest risk. If I, Mr. Qin, are caught, I will never betray any of you."
"At the same time, I also hope that if you are unfortunately caught, you will not reveal any other brothers."
Qin Yu spoke so impassionedly that Xiaozhi and others were moved.
Brother Yu is truly the greatest person in the world!
"Brother Yu, don't worry, even if I am removed from the sect, I will never betray anyone."
"Me too!"
"Okay, let's go and follow the plan!"
"Pay attention to spreading out a little and making the scene more realistic."
"After finishing this side, we also need to decorate the central square."
"I have inquired, and the Law Enforcement Peak disciples will conduct inspections at two in the morning and four in the morning, so everyone only has one hour, so hurry up and speed up the progress!"
After everyone left carrying the sacks, Qin Yu handed Li Zhengtong a black hood.
"I was in a bit of a hurry today and I forgot to bring this with me. These young disciples were so thoughtful!"
Li Zhengtong took the black hood and looked at Qin Yu in confusion.
Qin Yu slapped Li Zhengtong on the back of the head, "Silly, law enforcement officers won't catch those wearing hoods, they will only catch the slowest ones."
‘It’s not that brothers don’t show loyalty, but that brothers also have priorities!
’ Qin Yu thought in his heart.
Li Zhengtong suddenly realized.
"That's it!"
Later, Li Zhengtong returned the hood to Qin Yu.
Qin Yu: "What do you mean?"
Li Zhengtong: "I am the one who runs the slowest."
Qin Yu: "..."
